description:
Toddler Bed Rail Kit is a conversion kit that works with your matching crib, not a separate standalone bed. Make the switch from crib to big-kid bed gentle with the Toddler Conversion Rail.

Designed specifically for French Country cribs, this rail replaces the front of the crib to create a toddler bed your little one will love. Crafted from solid wood to match your French Country furniture, all hardware is included. The open design lets your child climb in and out on their own.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
